source.name: Dwarf
source.description:
Species Trait: Take Aim

Active when you have at least (N) different Dwarf pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Dwarves: All dwarves’ attack range +200, physical damage deals 15% increased damage for every 1 square away from the target.

source.lore: Dwarves are a bold and courageous species of humanoids that excel in creating and refining weapons and gadgets, allowing them to slay their foes from afar.

 Активируется, когда на поле есть хотя бы (N) разных Dwarf фигур. (Эффекты складываются)
